text:
lena: Heads-up: proposing a lean analytics event shape to reduce storage and improve console query perf. Idea: replace freeform profile_attrs + labels + large cost blobs with references (profile_id, label_set_id) and a 3-field cost_summary.

kevin: Which keys must keep original semantics for billing/routing?

lena: Must keep route_id, tenant_id, ts, tokens_generated, model_name/variant, and cost_summary(currency, bucket, unit_rate). Everything else can be referenced or sampled.

otis: Backfill approach? We need profiles and label_sets tables.

lena: Plan: dual-write for 2 weeks (v1 legacy envelope + v2 compact envelope). Populate profiles table from distinct attrs, then targeted backfill for hot routes only. Read layer will expand profile_id via cache.

tara: Alerting and QA depend on prompt snippets. If we drop raw_prompt we lose signal.

lena: Keep raw_prompt for eval-tagged requests and 0.5% random sample otherwise. Also keep full attrs for QA routes flagged in a config list.

kevin: Versioning and feature flags?

lena: Envelope schema = "analytics.v2". Reads default to v2; add query param legacy=true and admin kill-switch feature flag.

otis: Monitoring: profile-resolution-rate, profile-miss-rate, ingest 5xx rate, console p99. Also golden diff tests comparing top dashboard queries between v1/v2 during canary.

ingest-bot: canary-deploy: ingest-service:v2 started on cluster-eu-west-1 at 15% traffic.

tara: Docs & support: I'll draft migration notes and list dashboards to validate.

lena: Timeline: day0 RFC+PR, day2 canary 15%, day5 dual-write 100%, day10 targeted backfill for hot routes, day11 dashboard shim rollout, day30 review for full rewrite.

kevin: I'll own console compatibility shim; Otis will run backfills; Tara handles docs/validation. No red flags from infra.

ingest-bot: canary-deploy: ingest-service:v2 canary increased to 40% traffic.
